name: Sentinel
author: nixfred
description: Systemd and journal watchdog. A shield on the bar goes green when no unit has failed, red with a count when one has, and amber on a journal error burst. The panel lists failed system and user units with Restart and Logs buttons, the next 10 timers counting down, the err/crit rate since boot, the noisiest sources and services that have been auto-restarted. Read-only except the buttons. Local, no network.

barWidget.description: Failed systemd units and journal error bursts. Click for the watch panel.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often systemctl and the journal are read. One poll takes under a second.

schema.label: Show the error rate
schema.description: Adds the err+ lines in the last hour beside the shield.
